# Flowdeck

> AI-powered stock research platform with live market data, multi-agent analysis, portfolio monitoring, and conversational investment copilots.

## Product
- [How It Works](https://flowdeck.biz/how-it-works): platform overview and methodology
- [Trading Plan Specification](https://flowdeck.biz/tps): the structured output format Flowdeck's AI agents emit
- [Architecture](https://flowdeck.biz/architecture): technical architecture overview
- [Market](https://flowdeck.biz/market): live market data and ticker research
- [Newsroom](https://flowdeck.biz/newsroom): market news and analysis
- [API Docs](https://flowdeck.biz/api-docs): public API reference
